title: Chace's birth, parents and early flute study
summary: Born July 22, 1924, in Chicago to parents from New York who met there; he played flute through eighth grade and regrets wasting his high school years.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
